    • pattern

      public static Generator pattern(String pat)
      Generate strings from a pattern. Placeholders:
      • # — random digit (0-9)
      • ? — random uppercase letter (A-Z)
      • * — random alphanumeric
      Example: pattern("###-???-####") → "123-ABC-4567"

    • composite

      public static Generator composite(String separator, Generator... parts)
      Combine multiple generators with a separator. Example: composite(" ", firstNameGen, lastNameGen) → "Alice Smith"

    • template

      public static Generator template(String tmpl, GeneratorRegistry registry)
      Template with named generator substitution. Example: template("Dear {first} {last}", registry) → "Dear Alice Smith"

    • conditional

      public static Generator conditional(BooleanSupplier condition, Generator ifTrue, Generator ifFalse)
      Conditional generator — picks between two generators based on a runtime condition. Example: salary depends on department.

    • transform

      public static Generator transform(Generator base, Function<Object,Object> fn)
      Transform the output of a generator. Example: transform(nameGen, s -> s.toUpperCase())

    • format

      public static Generator format(String pattern, Generator... generators)
      Format string with generator values. Example: format("%s %s", firstNameGen, lastNameGen) → "Alice Smith"
